Adjustment.description: A change being tested: pause an item, or lower it, over a month range.
Adjustment.title: Adjustment

AgreementDraft.description: What is saved: the situation, the chosen adjustments, restoration rules and the person's own words.
AgreementDraft.title: AgreementDraft

Assumptions.description: Every rate is an explicit input. Annual, nominal, compounded monthly.
Assumptions.title: Assumptions

CalcAfterMaturity.description: What happens to a balance whose growth period ends before the common valuation date.
CalcAfterMaturity.title: CalcAfterMaturity

CalcCompareEntry.description: A saved scenario (`scenario_id`) or an unsaved calculator (`config`), with a label.
CalcCompareEntry.title: CalcCompareEntry

CalcStepUp.description:
From investment year `from_year` (year 1 = the first 12 months), the instalment changes.

`amount` sets the new instalment; `percent` raises the previous instalment by that fraction (0.10 = +10%).
CalcStepUp.title: CalcStepUp

CalculatorConfig.description: One calculator state. `mode` picks how every investment is valued.
CalculatorConfig.title: CalculatorConfig

CashItem.description: A monthly outflow. Goal contributions are transfers to savings, not spending.
CashItem.title: CashItem

Commitment.description: An existing fixed payment (for example an EMI) that stops after remaining_months.
Commitment.title: Commitment

CompareDiff.description: Change for one goal relative to the first scenario in the request.
CompareDiff.title: CompareDiff

CrowdedOut.description: Money that went to a higher-ranked goal while this goal received less than required.
CrowdedOut.title: CrowdedOut

ExpenditureProjectionRequest.description: `plan_id` uses the signed-in user's saved plan; `plan` projects an explicit hypothetical plan.
ExpenditureProjectionRequest.title: ExpenditureProjectionRequest

Expense.description:
A spending line.

A plain line has only `monthly` and behaves exactly as before: the plan-wide `expense_growth_annual` steps
it up once every 12 months from the plan's first month. Optional fields make it a schedule:

- `annual_growth` gives this line its own yearly growth instead of the plan-wide rate (a line can have one
  without any other schedule field).
- `start_month` turns the line into a scheduled one with an `amount` in a `frequency` (monthly, quarterly or
  yearly), an optional inclusive `end_month` (blank means ongoing) and optional `category`. `monthly` is then
  derived (the amount's monthly equivalent) and any value sent is replaced.

A scheduled amount is spread evenly over its frequency, like income. It is the amount paid from the later of
its start month and the plan's first month, and grows once every 12 months after that.
Expense.title: Expense

extra_savings_cap_pct_of_income.title: Extra Savings Cap Pct Of Income

GoalEffect.description: What a funded goal does to the balance sheet. A custom goal's effect is never guessed from its name.
GoalEffect.title: GoalEffect

HoldingCreate.description: One purchase of a stock, entered by hand. If the stock is already held, this is another purchase of it.
HoldingCreate.title: HoldingCreate

Horizon.description: How far to look: a number of months, or an age (which needs the reference age on the household profile).
Horizon.title: Horizon

HouseholdProfileResponse.description: The details the person has provided. A field that was never provided is null, never a default.
HouseholdProfileResponse.title: HouseholdProfileResponse

IncomeChange.description: Scale income for a month range. A multiplier of 0 models losing the income.
IncomeChange.title: IncomeChange

IncomeProjectionRequest.description: `plan_id` uses the signed-in user's saved plan; `plan` projects an explicit hypothetical plan.
IncomeProjectionRequest.title: IncomeProjectionRequest

IncomeSegment.description: Net monthly income over a range. `to_month=None` means the end of the horizon, duration unknown.
IncomeSegment.title: IncomeSegment

IncomeSource.description: One income stream as entered and as the engine used it. Its yearly amounts add up to the yearly totals.
IncomeSource.title: IncomeSource

IncomeStepUp.description: From `year` (January) the stream's base amount is replaced by `amount`, in the stream's frequency.
IncomeStepUp.title: IncomeStepUp

IncomeStream.description:
Planned (expected, take-home) income.

Two forms. A legacy stream has only `monthly_net` and the optional month `ends_after`; the plan-wide
`income_growth_annual` applies to it exactly as before. A scheduled stream has `start_year` and
`amount` + `frequency`, an optional inclusive `end_year`, its own optional `annual_growth` (a raise that
repeats every year), an optional `growth_start_year` (the first calendar year the raise is added) and
optional `step_ups`; the plan-wide growth is never applied to it. For scheduled streams `monthly_net`
is derived (the initial amount's monthly equivalent) and any value sent is replaced.
IncomeStream.title: IncomeStream

InfeasibilityReport.description: When no permitted plan works: the strongest plan you allow, and why it still falls short.
InfeasibilityReport.title: InfeasibilityReport

IntentSuggestions.description: Suggestions read out of a typed question by keyword rules. Not a calculation.
IntentSuggestions.title: IntentSuggestions

LinkedCommitment.description: Says a loan payment in the plan is the same loan as a recorded debt, so it is counted once (as the debt).
LinkedCommitment.title: LinkedCommitment

MarketQuoteResponse.description: A stored quote with its freshness, or an explicit "unavailable". Never an invented price.
MarketQuoteResponse.title: MarketQuoteResponse

Permission.description: What the person allows to change. Without one, an item cannot be adjusted.
Permission.title: Permission

PlanIn.description: `category` is a predefined category written `sys:<key>` or the id of one of the person's own categories.
PlanIn.title: PlanIn

Preferences.description: Settings that follow the person across the app.
Preferences.title: Preferences

ProposedChange.description: One exact edit to a record the person owns. Nothing is applied until they confirm this exact list.
ProposedChange.title: ProposedChange

ProtectedBalance.description: Money set aside for a goal or retirement. The evaluator never withdraws from it.
ProtectedBalance.title: ProtectedBalance

RecommendationComparisonRequest.description: Give `plan_id` to use the signed-in user's saved plan, or `plan` for an explicit hypothetical.
RecommendationComparisonRequest.title: RecommendationComparisonRequest

RestorationCondition.description: One test that must hold before a paused or reduced item starts to come back.
RestorationCondition.title: RestorationCondition

RestorationRule.description:
How an item that was paused or reduced "until restored" comes back.

Every condition must hold (a date can be one of them, never the only one). `steps` are the monthly
amounts to return to, in order; leave it empty to go straight back to the original amount. Each later step
starts `step_gap_months` after the one before. With `affordability_guard` a step that would take liquid
cash below the floor is deferred, not applied.
RestorationRule.title: RestorationRule

ReturnAssumption.description:
A return the person chooses for one holding, account or policy (`holding`) or a whole class. Nothing is assumed
for them: with none set, a value is held constant and the result says so.
ReturnAssumption.title: ReturnAssumption

ReviewRequest.description: What is true now. The review recalculates from `as_of_month` using only these updated figures.
ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest

ReviewSnapshot.description: Where each restoration stood at the review month. The date itself restores nothing.
ReviewSnapshot.title: ReviewSnapshot

Scenario.description: Everything that differs from the plan: shocks, priorities, assumptions, fixes.
Scenario.title: Scenario

SearchLimits.description: Explicit bounds on the search. Reaching `max_candidates` makes the answer incomplete, never "no solution".
SearchLimits.title: SearchLimits

SituationDraft.description: A suggestion to put into the form. Every field may be empty, and the person confirms each one.
SituationDraft.title: SituationDraft

SpendingMonth.description: What the person's Expenditure plans say they spend in one month.
SpendingMonth.title: SpendingMonth

TrajectoryRequest.description:
`plan_id` uses the signed-in user's saved plan; `plan` projects an explicit hypothetical plan.

The balance sheet always comes from the person's own records. `view`: baseline (current income, spending,
commitments and owned assets and debts, no future goals), selected_goals (baseline plus the goals named in
`selected_goal_ids` and their funding), or scenario (the same plus the `scenario` shocks).
TrajectoryRequest.title: TrajectoryRequest

TransactionCreate.description:
One actual, past transaction on a holding.

buy and sell: `quantity` and `price` (per unit). split and bonus: `ratio_new` and `ratio_old` (a 2-for-1 split is
2 and 1; a 1-for-1 bonus is 1 and 1). dividend: `price` is the amount per unit held on that date. `fees` are
brokerage and charges (for a dividend, tax or charges withheld).
TransactionCreate.title: TransactionCreate

Valuation.description: What the units are worth, and where that figure comes from. Never invented.
Valuation.title: Valuation

YearlyRow.description: One calendar year of the horizon, built from the monthly ledger and nothing else.
YearlyRow.title: YearlyRow

info.description: Explainable decision support for families with several competing money goals. Every number is reproducible and every suggested fix is verified. Illustrative, not financial advice.
info.title: ArthaYukti API
